reviews.review: This game is amazing I love playing this game with my friends definetly recommend!!

Very fun game, but it defintely won't appeal to everyone. The gameplay is very satisfying and becomes even better with friends. All of the classes have interesting and unique kits which are complemented by the vast array of items, which grows vaster as you play and unlock achievements. The soundtrack is excellent and the artstyle makes this game feel very distinct.

I don't understand why there is no save function in singleplayer or multiplayer. You can pause only in singleplayer, which makes no sense. The dev hasn't properly implemented multiplayer yet, so you need to forward ports or use hamachi, which is ridiculous in my opinion.
If you enjoy the binding of isaac, you will probably want to get this.

Also, for the third time now, the crashes almost immediately after alt + tab.

Risk of Rain is a rather fun and addictive game, overall not my first choice in time killing since it's much like most games that are rougelike, let me explain. The game works off your a character or class (which you unlock more or earn more for doing things in game) and your stranded on this planet that your cargo ship landed on, get out alive or die trying. A simple concept but it was all I needed to go headfirst. The games items range from goofy to what I call Ohhh items, so nothing wrong with the game but I just feel with all the current rougelikes and other games I sometimes will stop and think for a second thinking I could be playing them sometimes, Risk of Rain is like running into a brick wall and right now I'm sorta stopping myself from doing so, not to say it's a bad thing I mean sometimes you make a breakthrough but I just don't feel compelled enough to do so is the problem. The game stopped pulling me into it a bit too early and now I'm just sorta bored of seeing the same first level. Sure This game is fun as hell and it's a must have if you like brutal rougelikes but it's somewhat bland to an extent, it's not bad but just not my cup of tea. I did enjoy my time in it but I don't think I'd choose this game over something like Binding of Isaac or something else. I give it a good 8/10 and say a good day to ya sir or madam.
